adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` (and the UI uniqueness check uses `new Set(emails)`), both of which are case-sensitive. Since inputs are not normalized (e.g., `toLowerCase()`), `A@x.com` and `a@x.com` would be treated as different and can both pass the “not already an attendee” filter and be inserted via `createMany`.
